We'll group components: CLIENT (Web UI, Mobile App, Partner APIs); NETWORK (CDN, WAF, API Gateway, Load Balancer, Service Mesh); SECURITY (IAM, OIDC, MFA, Vault, KMS, RBAC, Secrets); COMPLIANCE (PCI-DSS, GDPR, SOC2); APPLICATION (Domain Services microservices per data product; Event Bus; AI agents maybe); DATA MESH nodes: Data Product A (Inventory), B (Orders), C (Logistics), D (Supplier); each has its own data platform (BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Spanner, etc.) plus vector search; also Data Catalog; Data Mesh Governance; Data Lineage; Observability; Messaging (Pub/Sub); AI/ML (Embedding Models, Vector Search); DEVOPS (GKE Multi-cluster, Anthos, Terraform CI/CD). Disaster Recovery via multi-region replication, backup storage, DR site.

Rate Limiting at API Gateway.

Let's craft flowchart.

Will use subgraph for grouping.

Need to ensure nodes have clear names.
